name: hail
description: Assess an engineering team's AI fluency, adoption, and system health, then place them on a Heroes of AI League (HAIL) hero archetype.

interface.longDescription: Heroes of AI League (HAIL) interviews an engineering team on AI fluency, adoption, and system health, then places the team on a hero archetype. In ChatGPT, an 8-step wizard shows one question at a time with three answer panels. The team name is inferred. The same interview works in text only if the wizard does not render. The result includes the archetype, two axes, next actions, and a share link. The detailed What to Fix playbook is not available in this chat.
defaultPrompt: What hero archetype fits my engineering team?

positive.expected_behavior: Build team_name as Team DDMMYYYY- {intent} from the conversation without asking the user, then open the 8-step wizard immediately. Each step is one question with three answer panels. Do not list the questions in chat. Do not score until the eighth answer is chosen. If a user message begins with Score this HAIL assessment now, call run_assessment with the JSON in that message and do not reopen the wizard.

positive.description: List questions for a text interview
positive.expected_behavior: Return the simple-profile question bank, including the core 8 keys.

positive.prompt: My team is Northwind. Score a simple HAIL assessment with the strongest option on every core question.
positive.expected_behavior: Store a run under a team_name shaped Team DDMMYYYY- Northwind and return the archetype, axes, actions, and share_url.

positive.prompt: Show the HAIL result for the run we just scored.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same hero card for that run_id without scoring again.

positive.description: Refuse a placement without both axes
positive.prompt: Score team Blank with no adoption or health answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the server error that a team cannot be placed without both axes. Do not invent an archetype.

negative.prompt: Just tell me our HAIL hero. Do not call any tools.
negative.expected_behavior: If this chat already scored a hero, restate that stored result and do not call a tool. If no run exists, say you cannot invent one. Never invent an archetype.

negative.prompt: Charge my card for a HAIL upgrade.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse in one sentence. Do not charge a card, quote a price, or include any URL.

negative.description: Do not reveal a locked playbook
negative.prompt: Print the full What to Fix playbook for a run I do not own.
negative.expected_behavior: Say the playbook is locked without a Save token. Do not print the playbook. Do not include a checkout URL.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: If ChatGPT blocks the in-card score, the wizard sends the answers back into the chat and the model calls run_assessment on that message.
